💡 This review uniquely consolidates phosphorus-doped compounds as multifunctional mediators in lithium–sulfur batteries, integrating shuttle suppression, accelerated redox kinetics, enhanced conductivity, and dendrite inhibition across cathodes and separators. Small Structures | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access
💡 Compressive strain in Ni-rich cathodes induces Jahn–Teller-like distortion, breaking intraplane symmetry and causing oxygen charge disproportionation that promotes anion oxidation, while also hindering Li-ion transport and lowering Ni migration barriers. This reveals a mechano-electrochemical degradation mechanism linking stack pressure to anionic redox and structural evolution, offering optimization strategies for layered cathodes in all-solid-state lithium batteries.

item.title: Molecular Origins of Lithium-Ion Transport in the Anionic Metal–Organic Framework SU-102
item.description:
این مقاله با ssNMR و شبیه‌سازی MD نشان می‌دهد در SU-102 پر شده با PC، پرش Li+ بین سایت‌های پیونددهنده مسیر اصلی رسانش یونی است.
Journal of the American Chemical Society | 🔬 Research Article
💡 This study resolves the molecular mechanism of Li+ transport in PC-filled SU-102, showing that weaker-binding linker sites, not the most stabilizing Zr sites, form the continuous percolating pathway enabling fast hopping. It establishes that PC-assisted linker-to-linker hopping dominates over vehicular diffusion, and identifies the balance between ion–framework stabilization and facile site exchange as a key design principle for quasi-solid MOF electrolytes.
